title: Business Development Specialist - Internal Sales
description:
About Ricoh
A global leader in digital services, recognised for innovation, sustainability and a people-first culture. We feature in the Gartner Magic Quadrant, are listed in the Global 100 Most Sustainable Companies, and have been named one of Forbes' World's Best Employers 2025.

At Ricoh, we believe people do their best work when they feel valued and supported. We create inclusive workplaces where you can grow, contribute, and make a positive impact while helping to build a more sustainable future.

Find your place. Transform your future

Our purpose is centred on understanding and improving how people work. By focusing on real working experiences, we support individuals to develop their skills, realise their potential and do work that feels meaningful.

People transform when they Love What They Do

This belief sits at the heart of The Ricoh Promise. It guides how we recruit, how we support our people, and how we work together every day, creating an environment where you can grow, feel valued and make a difference.

When you join us, you are encouraged to share your ideas, challenge the way things are done, and work with others to build something better. If you are looking for a place where your voice is heard, your development is supported, and your work feels meaningful, you will feel at home at Ricoh.

What you will be doing
- To be accountable for successfully driving sales across new and existing customers within an assigned territory, ensuring adequate pipeline is in place to achieve and exceed targets.
- To understand and confidently articulate Modern Workplace Supplies portfolio and Ricoh's value proposition, keeping up to date with knowledge of these products and services to enhance and maintain strong creditability with customers.
- To be responsible for communicating product updates, promotions and incentives and work with internal teams to plan, agree and deliver sales and marketing activities, ensuring successful execution of campaigns and events to help increase brand visibility, customer engagement and drive sales.
- To be responsible for prospecting, account mapping and engaging with new and existing customers to create and develop sales opportunities.
- To develop and maintain strong relationships across Ricoh vendor network, enabling successful engagement and ensure the promotion of products and services to maximise potential opportunities.
- To lead proposals, relevant bid or tender engagements for Modern Workplace Supplies opportunities to ensure high quality proposals are developed and an increased win rate for Modern Workplace Supplies opportunities
- To be responsible for regular forecasting, monthly reporting, and CRM management to ensure Ricoh Management can track progress against budget.

You will ideally have
- Proactive and entrepreneurial mindset, with the ability to take initiative and drive activity independently.
- Results-focused, resilient, and positive, with a strong commitment to ethical and inclusive behaviours.
- Strong communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively within a team environment.
- Excellent presentation and written communication abilities.
- Demonstrates confidence in influencing and engaging stakeholders at all levels.
- Team-oriented, with a supportive approach to wider business objectives.
- Highly self-motivated, organised, and capable of managing own workload.
- Eagerness to learn, with a strong appetite for continuous development.
- Knowledge of the Modern Workplace Supplies market advantageous.
- Proven experience in a sales or business development environment.
- Experience using CRM systems is desirable

In return for your commitment, you can expect
At Ricoh, work should feel meaningful, supportive and fulfilling. The Ricoh Promise shapes your experience through four pillars that bring our culture to life.
Love to Connect

You become part of a global community built on openness, inclusion and genuine collaboration.
Across teams, countries and roles, you'll find people who listen, involve and encourage you - helping you feel valued and able to be yourself every day.
Love to Grow

Your development truly matters to us. With access to learning pathways, mentoring and career opportunities across functions and countries, you'll be supported to stretch your skills, explore new directions and stay future-ready in a changing world.
Love to Give Back

Purpose is part of how we work. You'll have opportunities to make a difference through volunteering, sustainability initiatives and community programmes that reflect our shared values and commitment to positive impact.
Love to Succeed

Success at Ricoh is something we pursue together. You'll benefit from fair rewards, flexible working, wellbeing resources and real recognition - including programmes such as the Imagine. Change. Awards, where colleagues celebrate each other's achievements.
We are an equal opportunities employer
We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger, and we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. Our hiring decisions are based on skills, experience and potential, and we are committed to creating a fair and inclusive recruitment process. If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment journey, please let us know and we will support you to bring your best self forward.

Ready to love what you do? Apply now and help us shape what comes next.

title: Insurance Sales Executive
description:
Job Title: Trainee Insurance Advisor - Full Training Provided (No Experience Needed!)

Location: Northampton (Office-based)

Salary: £26,500 - £33,000 (Depending on experience/growth potential)

Hours: Monday - Friday, 08:30 - 17:00 (Plus 1 Saturday morning per month)

Kick start Your Career in Northampton - No Experience Needed!

Stuck in retail, hospitality, or sales, and looking for an office-based career with real progression and professional qualifications?

We are a close-knit, high-energy independent insurance brokerage looking for ambitious, people-focused individuals to join our team. We don't expect you to know anything about insurance-we care about your personality, drive, and communication skills, and we'll teach you the rest.

What's in It for You?
- Earn While You Learn: A competitive starting salary of £26,500 - £33,000, with clear milestones for pay increases.

- Collaborating with the team to hit collective milestones and earn bonus/incentive rewards.

About You:
- People Person: You're confident, chatty, and naturally good at building trust with anyone.

- Organised & Tech-Savvy: Comfortable navigating computer systems and keeping track of details.
- Ready to Learn: Willing to study for professional qualifications (good GCSEs, including Maths, are helpful here!).

Ready to start your next chapter? Hit 'Apply Now' and let's chat.

title: Internal Sales & Account Management Executive
description:
Internal Sales & Account Management Executive
Location: Northampton, NN6
Salary: £29,000 - £31,000 per annum
Hours: Monday-Friday, 8:30am-5:00pm
Job Type: Permanent, full-time
The Opportunity
We're recruiting on behalf of a well-established global manufacturing business in the metalworking industry. Due to the continued needs of the business, they are looking for an organised, commercially minded and proactive Internal Sales & Account Management Executive to join their busy, close-knit team.
This is an excellent opportunity for someone with experience in internal sales, sales administration or customer account management who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment where no two days are the same.
Supporting customers, external sales representatives and international markets across the UK, Ireland, Israel and Denmark, you'll play a key role in ensuring orders are processed efficiently, stock is managed effectively and customers receive an exceptional level of service.
Please note: This is more than a straightforward sales administration position. The role involves complex order management, technical product information, stock forecasting and problem-solving, so the successful candidate will need to be adaptable, proactive and confident managing competing priorities.

What's in it for you?
- Hybrid working: The option to work from home one day per week following successful completion of probation.
- Early Friday finish: A four-weekly rolling rota, allowing you to finish at 1:30pm on Fridays, with a reduced 30-minute lunch break to ensure contracted hours are completed. Available following probation.
- Bonus scheme: The opportunity to earn up to 18% of your annual salary through a performance-related sales incentive scheme, subject to achieving objectives.
- Annual leave: 26 days of annual holiday, plus bank holidays. The Christmas shutdown is provided without the need to use annual leave.
- Pension: Generous employer pension contribution of 10%.
- Training: Comprehensive training and ongoing support to help you develop your product and system knowledge.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage internal sales activities and maintain strong relationships with existing customer accounts.
- Process customer orders and enquiries using SAP and AI-supported platforms.
- Monitor orders, resolve queries and manage back orders to ensure timely delivery.
- Liaise with external suppliers to purchase additional materials and products when required.
- Manage material creation, product information and master data accuracy.
- Oversee consignment stock, inventory levels and stock forecasting.
- Work closely with external sales representatives to support customer requirements and account needs.
- Communicate with customers via telephone, email and Microsoft Teams, providing efficient and professional service.
- Prepare customs documentation, proforma invoices and other relevant warehouse paperwork.
- Identify and resolve order, stock and delivery issues, taking ownership through to resolution.
- Support customers across multiple international markets, ensuring accurate and timely communication.

What We're Looking For
- Previous experience in internal sales, sales order processing, sales administration or account management.
- Experience using SAP would be highly advantageous due to the complexity of the system.
- Strong organisational skills and excellent attention to detail.
- A confident telephone manner and professional communication skills.
- The ability to think quickly, solve problems and use initiative.
- A proactive approach with the ability to work independently and collaboratively within a small team.
- Strong IT skills, particularly Microsoft Excel.
- The ability to manage a busy workload and prioritise competing demands.
- Experience dealing with international customers would be beneficial.
- Experience supporting Danish-speaking or Danish-based customers would be an advantage, but is not essential.
- Full and comprehensive training will be provided. However, due to the fast-paced nature of the team, the ability to learn quickly and become confident in the role is essential.

If you have a background in internal sales, customer account management or sales order processing and are looking for a role offering variety, responsibility and a strong benefits package, we?d love to hear from you.
Apply today to find out more!
The successful candidate will ideally be available to start as soon as possible.

title: Junior Business Development Executive
description:
Junior Business Development Executive Healthcare

Location: Corby - Office based

Hours : Monday - Friday 08:30 - 17:00

Salary: Competitive salary and benefits

The Opportunity

Are you commercially minded, highly analytical and motivated by the opportunity to drive business growth?

We re recruiting for a Junior Business Development Executive to take ownership of an established territory within the healthcare sector. This is a varied role combining sales, strategic account management, territory planning and sales analysis, alongside administrative support to the senior management team.

We re looking for someone who can think strategically, interpret data, identify opportunities and turn insight into action. You ll need strong commercial judgement, excellent Excel skills and the confidence to build relationships with key decision-makers while taking ownership of your territory s performance.

You ll join a supportive, professional team that values collaboration, initiative and continuous development, with full training provided on the products.

Key Junior Business Development Executive Responsibilities
- Drive sales and growth: Develop and implement a clear territory plan to achieve sales budgets, increase market share and maximise commercial opportunities.
- Manage key accounts: Build and maintain long-term relationships with customers, stakeholders and decision-makers, identifying opportunities to grow existing business and develop new accounts.
- Analyse sales performance: Use Excel and sales data to monitor results, identify trends, assess account potential and highlight opportunities for improvement.
- Plan territory activity: Organise and document field visits, prioritising accounts according to sales potential, customer needs and geographical location.
- Maintain accurate reporting: Keep CRM records, sales forecasts, account plans and activity reports up to date, using data to support informed commercial decisions.
- Understand the market: Monitor competitor activity, customer requirements and market developments to identify opportunities and inform territory strategy.
- Develop product expertise: Build a strong understanding of the product portfolio and its applications, communicating relevant benefits confidently and accurately.
- Collaborate with colleagues: Work closely with the senior team and other territory managers to deliver a joined-up approach to customer service and business development.
- Provide sales and administrative support: Assist the wider sales function with reporting, planning, account information and day-to-day coordination.

About You

You ll be an intelligent, commercially aware and organised individual who enjoys working with both people and data. You ll be comfortable taking ownership of your workload, analysing performance and using evidence to make sound business decisions.

We re particularly interested in candidates who can demonstrate:
- Strong analytical ability and a logical, solutions-focused approach.
- Advanced Excel skills, including confidence working with large datasets, analysing trends, using formulas and producing clear reports.
- Excellent organisation, time management and territory-planning skills.
- Strong communication, influencing and relationship-building abilities.
- A proactive, tenacious and results-driven attitude.
- The ability to interpret information, identify patterns and translate findings into practical sales strategies.
- Confidence working independently while contributing positively to the sales team.
- A full, clean UK driving licence.

Experience and Background

Previous sales experience is beneficial, particularly in account management and business development

Experience selling into the NHS

However, we re also keen to hear from candidates with strong commercial and analytical skills gained in other sectors, provided they can demonstrate the intelligence, drive and relationship-building ability needed to succeed in a healthcare sales environment.

A degree-level qualification is desirable.

If you re a data-driven commercial professional who combines analytical thinking with strong relationship-building skills, and you re ready to take ownership of a territory and make a measurable impact on business growth, we d love to hear from you.

title: Sales Executive

As the Sales Executive you will develop & grow business within local dealerships, distributors, commercial businesses, farms, estates, workshops, OEMS & generally anywhere that need to purchase oils, paints, lubricants etc. for their machinery & equipment to either manufacture or service their own.

This key business development role covers Lincolnshire, Cambridgeshire & Northamptonshire & is 80% on the road field based, with one day a week working in the head office.

Duties:
- Field based sales & business development activities
- Maintain, develop & expand product/s spend levels with current clients
- Up sell & cross sell into current clients additional products
- New business development, pitching to & winning new clients
- Mapping out of the territory & pin pointing target clients (new clients)
- Defining & delivering a sales strategy that delivers tangible results
- Market research & market intelligence gathering
- Updating the internal CRM system
- Attending industry events & exhibitions
- Face to face, telephone & email sales activities
- Completing documents & sales reports

Attributes:
- Experienced sales / business development professional with experience or at least some knowledge of industrial & commercial paints, oils, lubricants, coatings & sealant type products or very similar product lines.
- Experienced selling into clients across several of the following sectors; agriculture, plant machinery, automotive, logistics (hauliers), off highway, marine, engineering & manufacturing.
- Strong knowledge of business opportunities in the Lincolnshire, Cambridgeshire & Northamptonshire areas.

This role would suit someone working as a Sales Executive, Business Development Executive, Sales Manager, Business Development Manager, Area Sales Manager, Territory Sales Manager, Sales Representative, Key Account Manager, Regional Sales Manager, Regional Business Development Manager, Field Sales Manager, Field Sales Representative or similar with similar sales & business development responsibilities.
